# AI Code Reviewer

> An automated code reviewer powered by a plugged-in language model, with an evaluation harness that measures bug-catching precision and recall on a labeled benchmark of bug-introducing diffs.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/ai-code-reviewer

## Source

- [src/ai_code_reviewer/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ai-code-reviewer/blob/main/src/ai_code_reviewer/__init__.py): AI Code Reviewer - automated code review with a bug-catching benchmark.
- [src/ai_code_reviewer/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ai-code-reviewer/blob/main/src/ai_code_reviewer/cli.py): Command line interface for the code reviewer.
- [src/ai_code_reviewer/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ai-code-reviewer/blob/main/src/ai_code_reviewer/data.py): A labeled benchmark of diffs, each marked as introducing a bug or clean.
- [src/ai_code_reviewer/diff.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ai-code-reviewer/blob/main/src/ai_code_reviewer/diff.py): A minimal unified-diff parser.
- [src/ai_code_reviewer/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ai-code-reviewer/blob/main/src/ai_code_reviewer/evaluation.py): Evaluation: line-level precision and recall of catching planted bugs.
- [src/ai_code_reviewer/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ai-code-reviewer/blob/main/src/ai_code_reviewer/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/ai_code_reviewer/provider.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ai-code-reviewer/blob/main/src/ai_code_reviewer/provider.py): The language-model provider interface, a deterministic fake, and a real client.
- [src/ai_code_reviewer/reviewer.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ai-code-reviewer/blob/main/src/ai_code_reviewer/reviewer.py): The reviewer: build a prompt from a diff, call the provider, parse comments.
- [src/ai_code_reviewer/rules.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ai-code-reviewer/blob/main/src/ai_code_reviewer/rules.py): A rule-based bug detector over added diff lines.
- [src/ai_code_reviewer/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ai-code-reviewer/blob/main/src/ai_code_reviewer/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the code reviewer.
